reply: A good place to start is the big fork in the road: Medicare can be set up in two main ways. Original Medicare is Parts A and B through the federal program; you can add a separate drug plan, and Medigap may help with your share of costs. Medicare Advantage is a private plan that provides Parts A and B, and most plans include drug coverage. Medigap goes with Original Medicare, not Medicare Advantage, and the Part B premium still applies either way. Once that distinction is clear, we can focus on practical help like doctors, medicines, and costs.
